card.name: Mixed spots in HIV and dosing text
card.fires_on: No single word or setting; it fires on scattered tokens such as 'during', 'AR' inside ZARXIO, a zero in '500 mg', and 'treatment' after 'consider'.

modes.label: Inside ZARXIO
modes.description: The 'AR' piece in the brand name ZARXIO.
modes.example: the risks and benefits of continuing Z<<AR>>XIO should be carefully considered

modes.label: After consider
modes.description: A word like treatment or therapeutic right after 'consider'.
modes.example: Monitor carefully and consider<< treatment>> modification.

modes.label: Acute-stage phrase
modes.description: 'during' or 'the' in the phrase about HIV-1 in the acute stage of infection.
modes.example: may not identify HIV-1<< during>> the acute stage of infection
